cards.title: Benefits of Reading Books
cards.text:
My uncle lives in a big city. He works as an engineer at a famous company. The company is located on Green Street, right at the end of the road. Every morning, he wakes up at 6:30 AM. He usually drinks a cup of hot coffee and eats an apple in the kitchen. The coffee gives him energy for a long day.

On Mondays, he leaves the house at 7:30 AM. He goes to work by bus because the traffic on the main street is always heavy in the morning. He meets his team in a large meeting room at 9:00 AM to plan the week. They usually talk about an important project. In the afternoon, he works on his computer in an office on the third floor.

At noon, he has lunch with a colleague at a small restaurant near the office. They often order a sandwich or an omelet. The food there is always delicious and cheap.

In the evening, he returns home at 6:00 PM. In summer, he likes to sit on the balcony at night to read a book. On weekends, he doesn't work. In July, he often goes on a vacation to the beach with his family. They stay at a nice hotel on the coast and enjoy a wonderful time together.

cards.title: Environmental Protection
cards.text: Protecting the environment is a major challenge for modern society. We must find a sustainable solution to reduce pollution and support green energy initiatives. Every community should encourage individuals to recycle and protect natural resources for future generations.
